artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Nothing was deployed; the artifact is a measurement made by get_item and scan in the same run; the checker reads the file at the committed bytes.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: READS6-AC1: the result file holds a state (or NO_ROW, or an error code) for each of the 14, the first READY id consistent with those states, and a ticket-id count whose parts add up to its denominator.
acceptance.output_evidence: job rows read READY: 14 of 14; ticket_id count 45 of 51 without / READS6-OK
acceptance.denominator: 14 job rows read of 14 READY-served ids (all tenant cottonwood, 0 denied, 0 NO_ROW); 1904 irpt-requests items scanned, 51 accepted analysis requests (49financial 11, cottonwood 39, inflection 1), 0 unreadable

read_can_see_a_row.description: The same get_item path returned a state string for every id, so a READY reading is a seen row and not a blind read; a denied read would have raised an error code, none did.

scope: READ-ONLY against AWS: DynamoDB get_item on irpt-jobs and scan on irpt-requests. No put, delete, invoke or apply.

declared_exclusions.item: Request accepted after the Y5 snapshot
declared_exclusions.reason: The count scan saw 51 accepted requests against 50 in the snapshot; the job-row list is the snapshot's 14 READY ids, so the new request is in the ticket_id count only.
